scope: New direct-teacher ablation with TL3 student and tied-lead teacher architectures, not historical TL3 recipe replay. All teachers are cold label-only fits; no production weights, warm initializers, propensity or family caches.

budget.amendment: Four paired student fits plus four unavoidable clean teacher prerequisites. Explicit eight-fit panel exceeds the usual 4–6 initial screen to retain two teachers on two clean folds without unknown ancestry. No automatic expansion.
budget.execution_authority: Preparation only; no local tests/training, no remote fit started, no paid allocation.

fit.normalization: canonical fitting-only two-batch estimate; state digest must match within student pair
fit.order: seeded epoch permutation; same fitting population, fixed drop-tail and updates within each pair
fit.student_objective: For each 2000-row TBPTT window: sum(w*(prediction-target)^2)/sum(w), w=abs(clip(y,-2,2))*valid, target=(1-alpha)*clip(y,-2,2)+alpha*clip(mean(two teachers),-2,2); alpha=0 versus0.5; one update per window; both arms consume identical caches.
fit.teachers: 263 input, tiedlead encoder, H256 x2, labels-only WMSE; past i1 snapshot at most recent i0 price event
fit.student: 211 input, linear projection, H256 x2, GELU head; cold paired initialization; no family head

metrics.primary: equal-cell mean of KD-minus-labels full-mixture official WP
metrics.uncertainty: paired component bootstrap conditional on fixed fits; two cells confound seed and fold; no significance claim
metrics.exposure: F0/F2 previously inspected, component-disjoint fitting does not make a fresh holdout
metrics.decision: both cells nonnegative and mean>=0.0003 warrants separately budgeted confirmation; mixed signs or zero-crossing interval remain uncertain; no adaptive coefficients/checkpoint selection

profile.device: one B300 per cell, paired arms on same device/runtime
